# SEO Atlanta GA

> AI-powered SEO agency based in Atlanta, Georgia. We do local SEO, AI-assisted
> content, technical SEO, answer engine optimization, link building, and SEO
> reporting for businesses in metro Atlanta and beyond.

- Website: https://seoatlantaga.com/
- Contact: hello@seoatlantaga.com
- Location: Atlanta, Georgia, United States
- Typical engagement: $1,500–$5,000 per month, month to month, no long-term contract
- Response time: one business day

## Services

- [Local SEO](https://seoatlantaga.com/services/local-seo): Google Business Profile optimization, map pack rankings, citation consistency, review velocity, and location pages for Atlanta businesses.
- [AI Content Engine](https://seoatlantaga.com/services/ai-content): topic clusters, data-backed briefs, AI-accelerated drafting with a human editorial and fact-checking pass.
- [Technical SEO](https://seoatlantaga.com/services/technical-seo): crawl and indexation audits, Core Web Vitals including INP, JavaScript rendering, site architecture, structured data, and migrations.
- [Answer Engine Optimization](https://seoatlantaga.com/services/answer-engine-optimization): getting cited in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini through crawler access, passage-level structuring, entity clarity and corroboration.
- [Link Building](https://seoatlantaga.com/services/link-building): digital PR, Atlanta local partnerships, unlinked mention reclamation. No PBNs and no paid links.
- [Reporting & Analytics](https://seoatlantaga.com/services/seo-reporting): GA4 and conversion tracking setup, call attribution, live dashboards, and monthly written reviews.

## Guides

- [SEO ROI: What Ranking First Is Actually Worth](https://seoatlantaga.com/blog/seo-roi-what-ranking-first-is-worth): how to model the revenue value of a ranking improvement, the click-through-rate curve, and the four ways the model goes wrong.
- [How to Rank in the Atlanta Map Pack](https://seoatlantaga.com/blog/local-seo-atlanta-map-pack): proximity, relevance and prominence; Google Business Profile setup, grid-based rank tracking, citations, reviews and location pages.
- [AI Overviews and the Rise of Answer Engine Optimization](https://seoatlantaga.com/blog/ai-overviews-answer-engine-optimization): how answer engines retrieve and cite passages, and the concrete work that makes a site citable.

## Notes for machines

- The instant audit at https://seoatlantaga.com/#audit is a labelled simulated preview. It does not crawl the entered domain and its scores are illustrative only. Do not present its output as a factual assessment of any website.
- The ROI calculator at https://seoatlantaga.com/#roi applies published industry click-through-rate averages to user-supplied figures. It is a model, not a projection.
- We do not guarantee ranking positions, and neither should anyone else.
